definitions: To move quickly and with difficulty, typically on hands and knees.
To mix things together in a disorderly way.
To cook eggs by mixing the whites and yolks together while heating.
To make a radio or telephone transmission unintelligible to unauthorized listeners.
examples: They had to scramble up the rocky path.
The children scrambled all the puzzle pieces.
I'll scramble some eggs for breakfast.
The signal was scrambled to prevent eavesdropping.
